checked_obligation: Verify that the substitution y=2n−1 transforms t²=12n²−12n+1 into t²−3y²=−2 while preserving the stated parity and positivity conditions.
reason: For positive integer n, y=2n−1 is a positive odd integer and n=(y+1)/2. Substitution gives 12((y+1)/2)²−12((y+1)/2)+1=3(y+1)²−6(y+1)+1=3y²−2, hence t²−3y²=−2. No external theorem is needed.
